To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) depot recycling increased significantly over time, (b) community and municipal depots were both important for promoting depot recycling, (c) the effect of the messaging was not moderated by the type of messaging, and (d) distance to the depot, access to a car, and baseline recycling were all significant moderators of the effects of the messaging.

(1) instructions alone were sufficient for improving community depot recycling, (2) the effect of instructions was maintained for municipal recycling at eight weeks, and (3) distance to depot, access to a car, and prior recycling behavior were significant moderators.
